text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the storage-oom postmortem — we left a handful of remediation actions unassigned. I sketched owners and timelines, please confirm or reassign and drop Jira links. Postmortem: https://redwood.company/postmortems/storage-oom-1942000000

devon: Thanks — I can take the autoscale config changes (item 2). timeline: 2 weeks. Will need a review from infra.

maria: @devon perfect. Can you own the rollout plan + canary?

devon: yep, canary plan included.

leah: I can take the alerting thresholds and runbook update (item 1). ETA: 3 business days.

samir: I'll own the KV cache eviction tuning (item 3) and add a perf test. ETA: 1 week.

maria: putting this into a quick RACI so we don't lose context — feel free to edit in thread:  
```
Item 1: Alert thresholds & runbook — R: leah | A: maria | C: devon | I: oncall
Item 2: Autoscale config & canary — R: devon | A: infra-eng | C: maria | I: sales
Item 3: KV cache tuning & perf tests — R: samir | A: eng-ml | C: devon | I: se-team
```

devon: small ask — can we split item 2 into config + infra-side changes? I'll track config but need infra ticket for capacity reservations.

maria: good call. split noted.

ops-bot: Jira ticket created: RED-6123 for Alert thresholds & runbook (linked by leah)

leah: RED-6123 created, added acceptance criteria + runbook draft. Tagging @maria for review.

samir: created RED-6124 for KV cache tuning & perf harness. Added baseline metrics and simulated load script.

devon: created RED-6125 for autoscale config (config work) — filing infra side as RED-6126 and pinging infra team.

maria: great — listing final action table w/ owners + target dates:  
- RED-6123 (Alerting/runbook) — leah — target 3 business days (1942007845)  
- RED-6125 (Autoscale config) — devon — target 2 weeks  
- RED-6126 (Infra capacity) — infra (assigned in RED-6126) — target 2 weeks  
- RED-6124 (KV tuning/perf) — samir — target 1 week  

leah: acked. I'll add playbook snippets to the runbook and link examples.

samir: adding perf artifacts to the ticket now. Also raising a note: this pattern of OOMs pops up when read-heavy bursts + cache churn coincide — recommend a recurring check.

maria: agree — adding a recurring remediation review as an action (postmortem pattern tracking). @devon can you add a weekly signal to Grafana for the pattern?

devon: yes — I'll add a dashboard panel + an alert that triggers when eviction rate + 99th latency both spike. Will reference RED-6127 for the monitoring work.

maria: can we sync up on handoffs if someone is OOO? pls add a secondary on each ticket.

leah: added @samir as secondary on RED-6123.

samir: added @devon as secondary on RED-6124.

maria: OK closing loop here — owners assigned, Jira tickets in place, RACI noted, and a recurring detection work item queued. I'll follow up in the weekly remediation sync to verify rollouts. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

devon: thanks — will post canary notes in RED-6125.

ops-bot: Reminder — weekly remediation sync scheduled: 2025-02-12 16:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).
